Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every three months as indicated by M3 in the title block. This document used 
for the boiler feed pump motor of unit 
1.
The first draft is initiated by 
eng.

revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Adel Abd el-Kader

approved by eng. 
Mokhtar Abd El-Latif Mady Head 
Sector of Ataka PS.
This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work order must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
A work order must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Before starting any work on the machine, check that it is switched off and 
 blocked up for switching on again.
The unit out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Tool set for tightness, cleaning tools as cloth.... etc
Lifting device, press-on and detaching device.
Oil for bearing.
Work to be Carried Out
Clean the heat exchanger
Examine visually bearing oil for cleaning, viscosity and color.
Every 6 month: carry out oil analysis and change it if required.
